entries.text: Thank you. I will work on that.
entries.easy_read:
You told me how to do better.
I say thank you.
I will try.

entries.text: What could I do better next time?
entries.easy_read:
I want to do better.
I ask what to change.

entries.text: Could you give me an example, please?
entries.easy_read:
I do not understand yet.
Please show me one time it happened.

entries.text: You are right. I will fix it now.
entries.easy_read:
I made a mistake.
I will fix it now.

entries.text: Thank you for telling me. May I think about it and come back?
entries.easy_read:
I heard what you said.
I want to think first.
Then we can talk again.

entries.text: You did that very well. Thank you.
entries.easy_read:
Your work was good.
I say thank you.

entries.text: One small thing: the labels go on the top of the box.
entries.easy_read:
I show you one small change.
Put the label on top.

entries.text: Could you check my work and tell me if it is right?
entries.easy_read:
Please look at my work.
Tell me if it is good.

entries.text: I understand. May I explain what happened from my side?
entries.easy_read:
I heard you.
I want to tell my side too.
Can I explain?

entries.text: I have changed the way I do it, as you suggested.
entries.easy_read:
You told me to change.
I changed it.

entries.text: Could we look at my progress at the end of the month?
entries.easy_read:
I want to know how I am doing.
Can we talk at month end?

entries.text: Thank you. I enjoyed working on it.
entries.easy_read:
You said my work was good.
I say thank you.

entries.text: May I suggest a small change that would save time?
entries.easy_read:
I have an idea.
It can save time.
Can I tell you?

entries.text: That was my mistake. I am sorry, and here is how I will avoid it.
entries.easy_read:
I did it wrong.
I say sorry.
I say how I will do better.
